title: A collection built from offsets the caller supplies, for mmseqs-style databases
body:
An mmseqs database frames its records with a null byte and keeps their offsets in a separate .index file, with the data split across pdb.0 to pdb.N. Scanning for a delimiter is the wrong primitive for it, so it does not fit Delimit. Index::new(format, offsets) can hold offsets a caller parsed out of the .index file, and the numeric key could serve as the name, which leaves two decisions:

1. How a .saidx tags a format libsail does not know. The header holds one format byte and the reader rejects any other value.
2. Whether split data files get a concatenating Source, or whether the caller is told to pass one file at a time.

The same two decisions cover a consumer-supplied Delimit. Raised while shaping sail-88cc19 and left out of it on purpose: nail's own plan uses libsail's FASTA and p7hmm delimiters and nothing else.
